title: Greywater Bay Rising
author: Ulyana Ashgrove
blurb: Lior Reyes, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
